_doc: Series tiles: each is an image edit of an existing tile, so a series shares one drawing and only the meaning changes (tools/draw_series.py). 'from' is the source key in the set's master folder, or with --from-dir a new candidate: tiny is an edit of the new huge (Mark: not big/little's elephant again), those of these. inside and on_top_of are not drawn: they reuse in and on through vocabulary.json's bundleImage, and a_lot reuses many.

above.edit: Lift the red ball straight up so it floats high above the yellow box, with a clear gap of white between the ball and the box.

below.edit: Swap their heights: the yellow box floats in the upper half of the tile and the red ball sits directly underneath it near the bottom, with a clear gap of white between them.

next_to.edit: Move the red ball off the box and down to the ground, right beside the yellow box on its left, both resting on the same level, close but not touching.

tiny.edit: Move the short black arrow so it points at the tiny rowboat instead of the cruise ship. Both boats stay exactly the same.

your_turn.edit: The child on the left now holds the dice out toward the child on the right and points at them; it is the other child's turn.

those.edit: Move the two red balls away from the child to the far right side of the tile, a little smaller but still clearly balls, sitting on a short ground line, and make the child point straight out at them instead of down at their feet.

tall.edit: Remove the yellow glow behind the mouse and put the same yellow glow behind the giraffe instead.

medium.edit: Add one short black arrow above the middle ball, pointing down at it. The three balls stay exactly the same.

a_little.edit: Remove the full glass. Keep only the glass with a little water, moved to the centre of the tile.

both.edit: Add one curved black bracket above the two apples that spans both of them, showing both together.

each.edit: Add a short black arrow above each apple, one arrow per apple, each pointing down at its own apple.
